record.question: Oak Tasar rearing alternate can be done by
record.explanation: Oak Tasar rearing can be carried out by the bottle method, which is the alternative rearing method among the listed options. Bush and branch rearing are the usual rearing-support methods and outdoor rearing is not an alternate-method term.
